item.title: Acme AI cuts API prices for Helio-7 mini
item.description: Acme AI announced a 50% price reduction for Helio-7 mini input tokens in the API, effective immediately for all prepaid and monthly billing accounts.

item.title: New fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs
item.description: The API now ships official fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs so teams can keep JSON schemas stable across model upgrades.
